root_cause.text: The nexthop replacement logic in `replace_nexthop_single` only updates the `has_v4` flag of nexthop groups when a nexthop's address family changes from `AF_INET` to `AF_INET6`, failing to perform this update when the family changes from `AF_INET6` to `AF_INET`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that the condition `oldi->family == AF_INET && newi->family == AF_INET6` in `net/ipv4/nexthop.c` was changed to `oldi->family != newi->family` to ensure `nh_group_v4_update` is called whenever the address family changes in either direction.

bic_trace_step.reason: This commit introduces the buggy logic described in the root cause. Specifically, in `replace_nexthop_single`, it adds the check `if (oldi->family == AF_INET && newi->family == AF_INET6)` to update the `has_v4` flag of nexthop groups. This only handles the transition from IPv4 to IPv6, failing to perform the update when a nexthop's family changes from IPv6 (`AF_INET6`) to IPv4 (`AF_INET`).
